title: The notes window shows decisions by default: show --notes renders notes and observations, counts gate evidence separately, and reaches gate rows explicitly, so the newest ruling is never buried under gate records
outcome: The notes window shows decisions by default: show --notes renders notes and observations, counts gate evidence separately, and reaches gate rows explicitly, so the newest ruling is never buried under gate records
acceptance: show REF --notes renders note and observation rows only, states the gate-evidence count for the item once, and offers show REF --notes --gates (or the history window) for gate rows; exact per-family counts and omitted counts remain; the continuation and locators are unchanged; a fixture with nine gate records after a verdict note shows the verdict on page one

completion.summary: Delivered default decision-focused note windows, explicit gate-inclusive reads, exact family counts and cursor-bound continuation across CLI and MCP
